info.title: Concept2Cure Submission Center API
info.description: Endpoints for the Submission Center (spec §4 workspaces). All require an authenticated bearer token (Authorization: Bearer); organization/user are resolved server-side and never accepted in the body. TypeScript shapes: shared/types/submission-api.ts. Human map: docs/legacy/SUBMISSION_CENTER_API.md.

get.description: Named, sourced eCTD validation criteria the gate checks against. Static reference data. Requires role regulatory-author.

post.summary: Validate file descriptors against a market spec's formatting rules (does not transmit)
Deterministic requirements gap assessment for a submission type
Deterministic eligibility assessment for a designation

get.summary: Post-submission change category catalog (FDA supplement / EU variation)

post.summary: Flag-driven change classifier (category + canonical sequence type)

get.summary: Reverse-workflow reviewer checklist for a submission type

post.summary: Required biocompatibility endpoints (ISO 10993) from contact nature/duration
Unified reverse-workflow device blueprint + readiness scorecard

get.summary: Global multi-region device strategy (build once, file many)

post.summary: UDI validation (GS1 check digit + AI parsing → GUDID/EUDAMED components)
Applicable electrical safety standards (IEC 60601) from device facts
Device labeling requirements (21 CFR 801 / MDR Annex I §23 / ISO 15223-1)

get.summary: Regulatory capabilities index (discover the whole device/IVD layer)

post.summary: Combination product assessment (21 CFR Part 3 PMOA → lead center)

get.summary: Pathway readiness projection (CTIS / MDR / IVDR / eSTAR) — deterministic, never transmits
Universal pathway manifest (assembled ToC for any non-eCTD pathway)
Device technical-file manifest (EU MDR/IVDR assemble structure)

post.summary: Materialize the MDR/IVDR technical-file ZIP (does NOT transmit)
Assemble step (drives the eCTD publisher off canonical leaves; does NOT transmit)

get.summary: Server-computed, tamper-proof dispatch gate inputs (read-only; does NOT transmit)

post.summary: Governed freeze (requires Part 11 e-signature actionId; applies e-sign + dispatch gate atomically)
Governed dispatch (requires Part 11 e-signature actionId; applies e-sign + dispatch gate atomically; does NOT transmit)
Transmit (assemble → send to agency gateway). Requires dispatched sequence, Part 11 e-signature, clear gate. Real transmission only when gateway credentials exist.

200.description: Transmit result (transmitted flag + reason when not configured)

post.description: text/event-stream: repeated event:chunk then event:done (GenerateSectionResult) or event:error.

post.summary: Classify a document to a CTD leaf (AI)
